title: Describe yourself in your own words
intro: Speak or type in English, French, or Arabic. You edit the transcript and approve every suggestion before it is saved.
inputLanguageHelp: This may be different from the interface language.
audioDisclosure: Audio is transcribed, then discarded by this application.
narrativePlaceholder: For example: where you live, your education, the tasks you can do, your experience, and your work goals.
narrativeHelp: You can edit the transcript before requesting suggestions.
consent: I agree to send this text to the AI assistant to create reviewable profile suggestions. It will not change my profile automatically. See the <privacyLink>privacy notice</privacyLink>.
reviewHelp: Nothing below is selected. Check only information that is accurate and that you want to add.
unmappedTitle: Useful details that were not mapped automatically
unmappedHelp: You can add these details manually to “About you.”
noSuggestions: No safe catalogue-backed suggestions were found. Your text was not saved.
confirm: Add selected suggestions to my profile
scoringBoundary: These details enrich your profile but do not change the current compatibility formula.

status.transcriptAdded: Transcript added. Review and edit it before asking for suggestions.
status.recordingStarted: Recording started. Press Stop recording when you finish.
status.recordingStopped: Recording stopped. Creating an editable transcript.
status.analysing: Analysing your description. Nothing is saved at this stage.
status.languageChanged: AI profile input language changed to {{language}}.

errors.unsupported: Audio recording is not supported by this browser. You can type your description instead.
errors.emptyAudio: No audio was captured. Please try again or type your description.
errors.transcription: The audio could not be transcribed. Please try again or edit your description.
errors.permission: Microphone permission was denied. Allow access or type your description.
errors.microphone: The microphone could not be started. You can type your description instead.
errors.consent: Confirm consent before sending your description to the AI profile assistant.
errors.narrative: Enter at least 10 characters about yourself.
errors.analysis: The profile assistant could not create suggestions. Please try again.
errors.selection: Select at least one suggestion to add to your profile.
errors.save: The confirmed suggestions could not be saved. Please try again.

setup.title: Let's build your ability-led profile.
setup.intro: Select the options that apply to you. This helps JoIn make opportunities and tasks easier to evaluate for your needs.
setup.privacyText: You can review and update these selections later from My Profile.
setup.aboutPlaceholder: A short introduction, interests, or work goals
setup.practicalHelp: Tell us how you currently read, write, and count. These are personal educational skills, not formal education levels. Support is a valid way of working.
setup.changeLater: You can update this later. Next, compare your profile with real job tasks.

errors.load: Your profile could not be loaded. Please try again.
errors.required: Add your name, location, education level, practical abilities, and at least one disability.
errors.save: Your profile could not be saved. Please try again.
